parameters.name: CpuArch
parameters.description:
The CPU architecture to which the driver is adapted. Valid values:

- armv7
- armv7-hf
- aarch64
- x86-64
- x86

parameters.name: DriverName
parameters.description: The driver name. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a letter and cannot exceed 20 characters in length.

parameters.name: DriverProtocol
parameters.description:
The communication protocol of the driver. Valid values:

- modbus: Modbus protocol.
- opc-ua: OPC Unified Architecture protocol.
- customize: custom protocol.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: IsBuiltIn
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the driver is a built-in driver.

- true: The driver is a built-in driver, which means the driver code is pre-installed on the gateway.
- false: The driver is not a built-in driver. You must upload the driver code. Default value: false.

    > You must upload the driver code for non-built-in drivers. To upload driver code by using an API operation and obtain an Object Storage Service (OSS) address, call the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) operation to create a pre-signed URL, and then use the OSS SDK to upload the driver file.

parameters.name: Runtime
parameters.description:
The language type of the driver. Valid values:

- nodejs8: Node.js v8
- python3: Python v3.5
- c: C language
